morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入并按独立词素记忆；skua 可读作 [skwa]。末尾 -dron 不是马来语后缀；不凭形式生造派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 空军中队；按《Kamus Dewan》的概括，通常由十至十八架飞机组成。
senses.en_definition: An air-force squadron, described by Kamus Dewan as comprising ten to eighteen aircraft.
senses.ms_definition: Formasi udara tentera yang menurut huraian Kamus Dewan merangkumi antara sepuluh dengan lapan belas pesawat.
senses.nuances: 飞机数量是词典概括；实际编制须看具体军队及单位。三项马来语释义均为依据词典编写的概括。[DBP：skuadron](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=skuadron)。

senses.zh_definition: 陆军中队，常见于装甲或骑兵编制；词典概括为团下辖约百人的单位，通常分成三个分队。
senses.en_definition: An army squadron within a regiment, described as approximately one hundred personnel, usually organized into three troops.
senses.ms_definition: Subunit rejimen tentera darat dengan sekitar seratus anggota, lazimnya tersusun dalam tiga trup.
senses.nuances: 不是空军专用词。trup 指其下属分队；具体编制依军种与单位而异。

senses.zh_definition: 海军舰艇中队；由两艘或以上同类型舰艇组成的单位。
senses.en_definition: A naval squadron comprising two or more vessels of the same type.
senses.ms_definition: Kumpulan tentera laut yang menghimpunkan sekurang-kurangnya dua kapal daripada jenis yang sama.
senses.nuances: 范围通常小于整支舰队 armada；中文具体译名应配合有关海军的编制。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 军方训练汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Skuadron helikopter itu menyertai latihan mencari dan menyelamat di kawasan pesisir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该直升机中队参加了沿海地区的搜救演习。
dual_scenarios.en: The helicopter squadron took part in a coastal search-and-rescue exercise.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Skuadron tu dah buat persembahan ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah skuadron itu sudah mengadakan persembahan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个中队已经表演了吗？
spoken_features: 句末 ke 构成口语是非问句。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Skuadron tu dah terbang ke? Aku baru sampai kat pintu masuk.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah skuadron itu sudah berlepas? Saya baru tiba di pintu masuk.
messages.zh: 那个中队已经起飞了吗？我刚到入口。
messages.en: Has that squadron taken off yet? I've just reached the entrance.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi. Diorang nak mula kejap lagi, cepatlah!
messages.ms_standard: Belum. Mereka akan memulakan persembahan sebentar lagi. Marilah segera!
messages.zh: 还没。他们马上就要开始了，快来吧！
messages.en: Not yet. They're starting in a moment—hurry!

etymology.historical_story: Skuadron corresponds to English squadron, whose history reaches back to Italian squadrone and squadra, associated with soldiers arranged in a square. The term subsequently became familiar in naval and air-force organization. Its older land-force connection explains why a skuadron in Malay can comprise soldiers or ships as well as military aircraft. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/squadron)、[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=skuadron)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 skua，联想 squad 的队伍感；再记三种画面：飞机、装甲兵、舰艇，都可能组成 skuadron。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式报道保留单位全称及编号；称呼军人时按其军衔或职务使用适当称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合军事编制及相关活动语境。普通运动队一般用 pasukan；避免把 skuadron、trup、rejimen 和 armada 当作同级单位。
